source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (biometric OR biometrics OR "electronic fingerprinting" OR fingerprinting) AND (India OR Aadhaar OR enrolment OR enrollment) AND (state OR welfare OR ethnography OR citizens)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(biometric OR biometrics OR "electronic fingerprinting" OR fingerprinting) AND (India OR Aadhaar OR enrolment OR enrollment) AND (state OR welfare OR ethnography OR citizens),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Aadhaar" OR "India" OR "enrollment" OR "enrolment") AND ("electronic fingerprinting" OR "biometric" OR "biometrics" OR "fingerprinting") AND ("citizens" OR "ethnography" OR "state" OR "welfare"))
